facts.fact: UAN is a 12-digit number allotted to each EPF subscriber, linked to the member's currently active PF account
facts.quote: Universal Account Number UAN is a 12 digit number allotted to each subscriber by linking it to the member’s currently active PF account number

facts.fact: Yes, an individual can generate a UAN themselves using Aadhaar if one has not already been generated
facts.quote: The UAN can also be generated by any individual using his/her Aadhaar if his UAN is not already generated.

facts.fact: Self-generation is now done through Aadhaar face authentication on the UMANG app (direct allotment on the member portal has been discontinued)
facts.quote: The facility for Direct UAN Allotment through this portal has been discontinued. You can now easily generate your UAN through Aadhaar-based Face Authentication (FAT) on the UMANG App .

summary: EPFO FAQ confirms 12-digit UAN and self-generation with Aadhaar; the member portal confirms generation now only via Aadhaar face authentication on UMANG; all confirmed.
